# Organic Spa and Nails

> Nail salon & spa based in Austin, Texas. Organic Spa and Nails on East Riverside does over-the-top designs, picture-perfect sets and deluxe hot-stone pedicures, with drinks offered and usually no wait.

- Phone: (512) 953-5262
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Del Valle, Manor, Pflugerville, Bastrop
- Yelp rating: 3.7 from 412 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/organic-spa-and-nails/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/organic-spa-and-nails/book.html

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Classic, gel and shellac manicures with clean cuticle work and even polish.
- Pedicures: Relaxing pedicures with soak, scrub and massage.
- Dip & full sets: Dip powder (SNS), acrylic full sets and fills in any shape.
- Nail art: French tips, chrome, seasonal designs and art copied from your photo.

## About
Organic Spa and Nails is on East Riverside Drive, a short ride from UT. Techs including Diana, Mochie and Tony do gel, acrylic, drip designs and deluxe pedicures with hot stones and massage. Clients say the salon is super clean, there's usually no wait, and the techs love having fun with your ideas. Burnt-orange game-day sets are easy to ask for.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins at Organic Spa and Nails?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To skip the wait, call (512) 953-5262 or book online.
- Q: Where is Organic Spa and Nails?
  A: 1920 E Riverside Dr, Ste 130, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: What nail services do you offer?
  A: Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, acrylic full sets and fills, nail art and waxing.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo and your tech will match the shape, color and design.
- Q: What do clients say about Organic Spa?
  A: Organic Spa and Nails is rated 3.7 stars from 412 Yelp reviews. Clients mention fun, over-the-top designs, a very clean salon and great hot-stone pedicures.
- Q: Can you do Longhorns game-day nails?
  A: Yes. Burnt orange and white French tips, drips and accents are a favorite. Bring a photo or let your tech design it.
